purpose: Supporting hidden-area reconstruction and overscan; original approved paintings remain authoritative

prompts.stage: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target: the supplied Voyagewright twilight island landscape. Create production matte-painting OVERSCAN ONLY for a cinematic 2.5D scene. Keep the entire supplied composition intact as the central 70 percent width and central 70 percent height of a larger 16:9 landscape canvas. Do not move, redesign or replace the distinctive tall central island, low moon at left, warm pinprick shoreline lights, foreground right wooded rock, small middle foreground rocks or their reflections. Zoom the source out into the central area and continue its sky, water, distant karst islands and shoreline naturally beyond all four edges. Preserve its precise blue violet twilight palette, soft peach horizon, painted realism and quiet water. Extend to left and right with distant low silhouettes, down with natural quiet ocean and a little right-edge rock continuation, up with continuous night sky. ONE moon only in its original source location, no new hero objects, no text, no frames, no panels, no borders, no duplicate mountains. Output a single continuous opaque wide landscape image at the highest practical resolution. This is hidden-area extension of approved art, not a new design.
prompts.stage_backing: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target: the supplied expanded twilight island panorama. Produce a HIDDEN-AREA BACKING matte for this exact panorama with identical camera, framing, colors and pixel registration. Remove ONLY the close wooded rocky island occupying the right third (including its palms and foreground rocks), the strip of small rocks across the lower middle, and the small sailboat/rock at left of the moon. Reconstruct quiet reflective blue water, continuous distant coastline and any sky that these foreground rocks occlude. Keep the large central tall distant mountain, its shoreline lights, low left moon, stars, cloud shapes and peach-purple horizon exactly where they are. Do not zoom, resize, redesign the world, change its palette, add islands, introduce new features, text, or move the moon. This is the same scene with the close foreground occluders removed, for real parallax layering. Opaque full landscape image.
prompts.stage_distant: Use case: precise-object-edit. Input is a hidden-area backing of the approved twilight island panorama. Keep framing, camera, color, the low moon at left, ocean horizon and cloud patterns fixed. Remove ONLY the large central tall island/mountain mass and the connected dark peaks from approximately the middle 35 percent through 80 percent of the image width. Inpaint the sky and distant misty low horizon ridges behind that removed land, and quiet reflective water below. Keep far left and far right distant ridgelines where possible. No new nearby islands, no boats, no new moon or sun, no lettering. This is a distant SKY/WATER BACKING layer behind a separately extracted mountain; the extracted original mountain will cover most of the filled area. The backing must be continuous and subdued, opaque, in the exact original landscape crop.
prompts.exterior: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target: this exact moonlit night harbor exterior. Extend its canvas by approximately 25 percent at left, right, top and bottom for cinematic camera overscan. Keep the supplied image composition as the central two-thirds of the expanded image, unchanged: same moon at upper right, same layered dark karst peaks and warm coastal lights, same right-side timber pier, same blue rippled water and moon reflection. Add only natural continuation of existing sky, distant coast and water outside the original crop. No room, no ceiling or curtains, no new nearby buildings or new hero objects, no second moon, no text, no borders or framing. Do not relight or redesign the existing scene. Preserve its soft painterly realism and dark quiet night palette. A single seamless opaque matte painting with expanded world area, not stretched or mirrored edges.
prompts.room_overscan: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target: the owner-approved Voyagewright timber Muster room. Create ONLY generous hidden-area architectural overscan: place the unchanged existing room composition inside the central two-thirds width and central two-thirds height of a larger 3:2 canvas, continuing the ceiling beams above, structural side walls left and right, and timber floor/table edges below. Maintain the exact accepted room design, warm lantern illumination, nighttime window view, moon, all furnishings and their relative locations. Do not add new furniture, lights, signs, text, creatures, windows or doorways. No mirrored edges or stretched vertical bands. This is supporting matte material beyond the approved crop for a backward dolly, NOT a redesigned room. The original source painting will be composited over the center, so prioritize seamless continuation at its boundaries. The nearest large hanging lantern is independently extracted: do not duplicate it outside its original location. Output one continuous opaque room painting.
